# KittenTTS 2

KittenML · released 2026-10

KittenML/kitten-tts-2 (README: 1.7B parameters, ternary-packed language model of about 506 MiB) with the ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo s3gen decoder it downloads. Weights under the Stellon Labs Community License (free below USD 1M revenue); code Apache-2.0. Released 2026-10-02.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/KittenML/kitten-tts-2)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

```sh
pip install kittenml && python -c "from kittenml import KittenTTS; import soundfile as sf; m = KittenTTS('KittenML/kitten-tts-2'); audio = m.generate('One day, a little girl named Lily found a needle in her room.', voice='Bruno'); sf.write('output.wav', audio, m.sample_rate)"
```
